items.source: Default typically equals NO, unless a different default has been configured at the component-scan instruction level.
items.translation: 默认值通常为 NO，除非已在组件扫描指令级别配置了不同的默认值。

items.source: This proxy-mode is not typically useful when used with a non-singleton scoped instance, which should favor the use of the INTERFACES or TARGET_CLASS proxy-modes instead if it is to be used as a dependency.
items.translation: 此代理模式在与非单例作用域实例一起使用时通常没有太大用处，如果将其用作依赖项，则应更倾向于使用INTERFACES或TARGET_CLASS代理模式。

items.source: For a more complete discussion of exactly what a scoped proxy is, see the Scoped Beans as Dependencies section of the Spring reference documentation.
items.translation: 有关 scoped proxy 的更完整讨论，请参阅 Spring 参考文档中的作为依赖项的作用域 Bean部分。
